name: ai-enabler
displayName: AI Enabler — machine-driven delivery from Jira
description: Takes a Jira ticket to a pull request with the machine doing the work and the human deciding at two gates. `/ai-enabler:delivery-run PROJ-123` reads the ticket through the Jira MCP server and runs a pipeline of dedicated subagents — ticket analyst, ticket refiner, repo scout, solution planner, code implementer, test engineer and parallel read-only reviewers — then commits, pushes, opens the pull request and updates Jira. Each stage is also a skill of its own: delivery-plan, delivery-implement, delivery-test, delivery-review, delivery-ship, plus delivery-doctor to check the setup, and delivery-ticket-refine and delivery-ticket-create to turn a thin ticket or a few sentences into a robust one, as a local file. No spec-driven process required.
